category: using AI effectively and responsibly at work
prompt: Tell me about how you used AI to improve a real workflow, what remained under human judgment, and how you verified the output.
Choose the strongest metric on the resume. Ask for its numerator, denominator, data source, baseline, and causal caveat.
Choose a technically impressive bullet. Ask what the candidate personally implemented versus what the team already had.
Choose a model or algorithm. Ask why that approach beat the simplest reasonable baseline and what failed first.
Choose a data pipeline. Ask where data quality could silently fail and how the candidate detected it.
Choose an experiment. Ask about randomization, sample size, guardrails, and what result would have changed the decision.
Choose an impact claim. Ask how the candidate knows the work caused the outcome rather than merely correlating with it.
Choose a project with many tools listed. Ask which tool was essential, which was replaceable, and why.
Choose a collaboration claim. Ask for the exact disagreement, the candidate's recommendation, and what was ultimately rejected.
Choose a research project. Ask the candidate to explain its core technical idea to a business leader in sixty seconds.
Choose a shipped product. Ask what the candidate would remove if engineering capacity were cut in half.
Choose a result that improved. Ask what countermetric might have worsened and whether it was monitored.
Choose a project. Ask which assumption is most likely wrong and how the candidate would test it next week.
